mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ms_table ( store_id, table_number, table_number_prefix, start_table_number, end_table_number, state, remark, create_by, create_time, del_flag ) VALUES
( #{item.storeId}, #{item.tableNumber}, #{item.tableNumberPrefix}, #{item.startTableNumber}, #{item.endTableNumber}, #{item.state}, #{item.remark}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.delFlag} )
mapper.select: SELECT t1.table_id, t2.store_id, t2.store_name, t1.table_number, COUNT(t3.order_id) AS orderNumber, IFNULL(SUM(t3.actual_pay), 0) AS amountSpent, MAX(t3.create_time) AS lastOrderTime, t1.state FROM ms_table AS t1 LEFT JOIN ms_store AS t2 ON t1.store_id = t2.store_id LEFT JOIN ms_order AS t3 ON t1.table_id = t3.table_id ${ew.customSqlSegment} GROUP BY t1.table_id, t2.store_id, t2.store_name, t1.table_number, t1.state ORDER BY t1.create_time DESC
